summary: Completed comprehensive backend testing of Responsabilidad Económica module (Fase 2C.1). All 23 tests passed (100%). Verified calculation logic for faltantes/sobrantes, tolerance application, minimum charge threshold, configuration management, and workflow state transitions.
critical_code_review_comments: Responsabilidad module correctly implements economic impact calculation for inventory differences
Tolerance logic correctly excludes small differences (within tolerancia_unidades or tolerancia_porcentaje)
Sobrantes are registered but do NOT compensate faltantes by default (permitir_compensacion_faltantes_sobrantes=false)
Workflow correctly transitions to EN_REVISION_FINANCIERA after calculation
Configuration persists correctly in configuracion_operativa collection
forzar_recalculo parameter allows recalculation of existing records
seed_data_creation: Used existing test workflows with diferencias: (1) workflow with tolerance, (2) workflow with large faltantes, (3) workflow with only sobrantes
context_for_next_testing_agent: Responsabilidad Económica module (Fase 2C.1) fully tested. Key findings: 1) GET /api/v2/responsabilidad/configuracion returns config with cargo_minimo=100, tolerancia_unidades=3, tolerancia_porcentaje=1.5%, compensacion=false. 2) PUT /api/v2/responsabilidad/configuracion updates and persists config. 3) POST /api/v2/responsabilidad/calcular/{workflow_id}?usuario_id=X calculates economic impact. 4) Calculation creates record with estado=CALCULADO and updates workflow to EN_REVISION_FINANCIERA. 5) monto_propuesto = faltantes_valor - valor_excluido_por_tolerancia (sobrantes do NOT reduce it). 6) excede_minimo=true when monto_propuesto >= cargo_minimo_mxn.
